candidate.detailsJudgement: Small details preserved in the exact final renders: red flag accent, teal swash overlap, white gaps between monogram strokes, and the detached underline bar all render crisply at 240px on light and dark themes; no lost strokes or merged shapes.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Source proportions preserved: no crop, stretch or distortion; the 60x60 source cell already fits the square catalog cell; the emblem occupies the same relative area as in the source with its own built-in clearances.
candidate.rationale: Update candidate for 15419 (КРЕДІ АГРІКОЛЬ БАНК): the accepted icon is a non-equivalent variant (CA monogram only, no underline bar, off-palette colors #306D4F/#449A9C/#DB3832). The candidate is derived losslessly from the bank's own production-site vector (logo-credit-agricole-small.svg, Illustrator-exported inline paths) and carries the current official mark: monogram + teal swash + red flag + dark-green underline bar in official colors #008B92/#00664B/#E30613. Working SVG prepared by keeping only the in-viewBox (0 0 60 60) source elements and removing the two white background rects and off-canvas sprite content; no path geometry or paint was redrawn.
transforms: Extraction of in-viewBox content from the official sprite-style SVG (kept 6 of 88 drawable elements: 5 paths/rects forming the emblem, incl. underline rect x=10.9 y=40.7 36.9x3.3); removed white background rects (x=0 60x60, x=618 160x160) and off-canvas sprite content; added explicit SVG namespace; no geometry or color edits.

Background-only backing removal: the source's white background rects were dropped, preserving full emblem, official colors and alpha; no circular mask applied (source presentation is transparent-backed emblem on plain field).

SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree config (sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e): 1095 -> 776 bytes; selected optimized result (evidence/15419/optimize-1/svgo-receipt.json); working vs optimized renders pixel-identical via rsvg-convert (diff bbox None).
candidate.variant: Standalone square-fitting brand mark: CA monogram with integral underline bar, no accompanying wordmark — same variant the bank itself uses as its touch-icon standalone presentation.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Base versus final: the accepted icon lacks the dark-green underline bar and uses off-palette colors (#306D4F/#449A9C/#DB3832) versus official #008B92/#00664B/#E30613; the candidate restores the official with-underline variant and exact brand colors. This is a supported variant/color correction against the bank's current official mark, not a serialization-only change. Backing role: the source emblem is a transparent-backed mark on a plain field; only the incidental white background rects were removed (background-only, zero emblem loss); no official circular avatar of this variant was observed, so no circle adaptation was applied; the whole emblem including the detached underline bar survives and is recognizable at catalog size on both themes.

proposals.reason: Crédit Agricole Ukraine is an operating brand (credit-agricole.ua, live 2026-10-03). Its current official mark is the CA monogram with green underline bar in brand colors (teal #008B92, dark green #00664B, red #E30613), observed on the official homepage header (logo-credit-agricole-small.svg), og:image and touch-icon-144.png. The existing accepted icon.svg (f5a5776e…) is a non-equivalent variant: monogram only, without the underline bar, in off-palette colors #306D4F/#449A9C/#DB3832. A supported update: variant/color correction with an original vector source (Illustrator-exported inline SVG, 82 paths, viewBox 0 0 60 60, served by the bank's own production site).

sourceCandidate.rationale: Current official logo served by the bank's own production site; genuine original vector (Illustrator-exported inline SVG paths, not a traced copy). Identity confirmed (same CA monogram), currency confirmed (in live use on the operating bank's site, observed 2026-10-03), standalone square-fitting mark (monogram + integral underline bar, no accompanying text), matching the bank's own touch-icon presentation. Differs from the accepted icon in variant (missing underline bar) and brand colors, justifying an update candidate; render gates and human MR review remain in candidate preparation.
